posts.title: 'Othello' scene by scene 14: Act 4 scene 2
posts.description: In Act 4 scene 2, the headlong pace of the story is ramped up further. Othello is certain of Desdemona's infidelity; Emilia is getting close to the truth; Roderigo is demanding 'satisfaction.'
